sentences.en: Feeling rather peckish I thought I'd slip inside and treat myself to a slap up meal.

sentences.en: Then we 're goin ' for a slap-up meal an ' tomorrow you can go into town an ' get some new clothes.

sentences.en: Our food service can provide anything you wish Ã¢ from a small finger buffet to a sit-down slap-up feast.

sentences.en: We were treated to a slap-up meal with every kind of seafood imaginable.

sentences.en: We usually had one slap-up meal a day.
